JUKO-KAI INTERNATIONAL ® was founded in the year of 1961 and is one of the oldest martial arts organizations in the United States. The founder of Juko-Kai is Rod Sacharnoski, Dai-Soke, 10th dan, a world renown Grandmaster. Juko-Kai is a family oriented martial arts organization that has schools and representatives throughout the United States and in several foreign countries and has long been recognized as one of the foremost martial arts federations in the West. Juko-Kai serves as the Western Headquarters for the International Okinawan Martial Arts Union (IOMAU) and has, since the 1980s, served as an authorized headquarters and representative for Shian Toma, Soke, Headmaster of the All Okinawa Seidokan Karate and Kobudo Renmei, Okinawa/Japan.

*ALL JUKO-KAI MARTIAL ARTS AND WAYS ARE ASIAN RECOGNIZED AND SPONSORED.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.22.2″ _module_preset=”default” custom_css_main_element=”margin: auto;” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.22.2″ _module_preset=”17fc604e-6b79-4f0d-85b1-284f116d4319″ text_font=”|600|||||||” text_text_color=”#F7F7F7″ text_font_size=”14px” text_orientation=”center” custom_margin=”||||false|false” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

In addition to representing various traditional organizations of Okinawa/Japan, Juko-Kai teaches the personal Sokeship (founder-ship) arts of Soke Sacharnoski, collectively referred to as Juko-ryu Bujutsu (closed division) and Juko-Kai Nihon-ryu (open division) which accepts all styles of credible Japanese/Okinawan graded dan degrees for membership. Additionally, Juko-Kai members have the option to study the world famous Juko-Ryu system of Combat-Ki™ as well as the registered art of Tai-Ki ©.

If you are a martial arts instructor who actively operates a dojo or association, who is seeking an affiliation and/or sponsorship, please submit an application to Juko-Kai. It may well be the best martial arts decision you’ve ever made. You can expect low promotion and membership fees, excellent service, no politics, outstanding arts to study, and ongoing opportunities to advance in rank based solely upon your continued attainments.
